_meta.role: Embedded Systems Engineer, Quantum Energy Systems

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on embedded systems experience building real-time firmware on STM32 and Arduino microcontrollers. Designed interrupt-driven sensor and actuation pipelines -- closed-loop UART/I2C sensor communication, PWM motor control, and ToF-triggered safety logic -- validated through custom PCB board bring-up in EAGLE and hardware debugging with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. Comfortable owning firmware end-to-end, from datasheet-driven driver development to deterministic real-time control loops.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots, owning board bring-up end-to-end; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control, integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through hardware-in-the-loop calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in bare-metal C with timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver; programmed GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1 peripherals directly.
Achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified timing and signal integrity in Proteus.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands under FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on STM32.
Integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization for closed-loop actuation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Delivery Drone
bullets: Built an Arduino flight controller in C++: clamped PWM throttle mapping to 4x 30A SimonK ESCs with a safety-gated arming sequence and per-motor override.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) -- MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) via TCA9548A I2C mux for a contact-aware grasping safety interlock.
Resolved 11 hardware-software integration failures (servo brown-out, stale-frame capture, false-positive detections); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
